gad.label: Generalized anxiety disorder
gad.query: ("Anxiety Disorders"[MeSH Terms] OR "generalized anxiety"[Title/Abstract] OR "anxiety disorder"[Title/Abstract])

depression.label: Depression
depression.query: ("Depressive Disorder"[MeSH Terms] OR "depressive disorder"[Title/Abstract] OR "major depression"[Title/Abstract] OR "depressive symptoms"[Title/Abstract])

ptsd.label: Post-traumatic stress disorder
ptsd.query: ("Stress Disorders, Post-Traumatic"[MeSH Terms] OR "posttraumatic stress"[Title/Abstract] OR "post-traumatic stress"[Title/Abstract] OR PTSD[Title/Abstract])
